discription: A percussive noise sound with a sharp attack and quick decay, shaped by a band-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, atk=0.01, dec=0.2, sus=0.0, rel=0.1, cutoff=4000, rq=0.5;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(atk, dec, sus, rel, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = WhiteNoise.ar;    sig = BPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
